description: Graph-vs-traditional retrieval evaluation suite (spec US4). Hard queries: expected node is >=2 graph hops from the query's textually nearest node (audited against full build 2026-11-09, commit d7e2f96, 2361 nodes). Easy queries: target name lexically similar to query tokens.

queries.query: regime detector classify volatility
queries.justification: target class name tokens (regime, detector) directly overlap query tokens

queries.query: kelly criterion analyzer
queries.justification: target qualified name contains all query tokens

queries.query: signal journal record decision
queries.justification: target symbol/file tokens (signal, journal) overlap query directly

queries.justification: exact class-name match

queries.justification: query uses passive concept phrasing; target is a private underscore method name sharing only one token

queries.query: which function slices orders into hidden pieces
queries.justification: iceberg slicing is described conceptually; private method name shares no query token; structural relation via engine class only

queries.query: what writes the trade execution details record
queries.justification: private writer method; query paraphrases (writes, record) without name tokens

queries.query: which helper loads previously processed export files
queries.justification: loader is underscore-private; query avoids its literal name; >2 hops from textually nearest sync entry points

queries.query: where does the listener record per signal health rejections
queries.justification: rejection counters surface via stats accessor, not a rejection-named symbol; conceptually distant

queries.query: what code reacts when a model gate fails
queries.justification: gate-failure handling (rejected status) is structurally embedded; file node target reachable only through registry symbols; lexical nearest nodes are gate/threshold modules

queries.query: who consumes the weekly outcome report after close
queries.justification: weekly report consumption lives in scheduler flow; no query token appears in file name or its top symbols; >2 hops from report-named modules

queries.query: what positions sizing responds to high volatility
queries.justification: volatility response flows regime->sizing; calculator name lacks volatility tokens; structural distance measured at build time

queries.query: which module decides entry approval from win probability floor
queries.justification: approval-floor logic described conceptually; module name shares no approval token; nearest lexical nodes are predictor modules

queries.query: where do heartbeat files get validated before alerts
queries.justification: validation-before-alert flow is inside main; heartbeat token overlaps but entry function name shares none; >2 hops
